# Elements

Every element is written `kind [positional] { props; children }` (spec.md, section 6.1). `element text(text -> text)` means the positional is a `text` that fills the `text` prop. A prop marked `<->` may be bound two-way; an inherited prop reaches every descendant.

## Prop groups

### `node`

```strand
group node
```

What every element accepts. Every visual prop springs; `x`, `y`,
`scale`, `rotate` and `opacity` are paint-only and never relayout.

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `Node` | Names the element, so others read its state (`results.selected`) and keys route to it (`nav: results`). |
| `width` | `length \| auto` | Its width: logical pixels, or `40%` of the parent; `auto` (as unset) sizes it by what it holds, and takes a transition there (`width: auto ~ instant`). |
| `height` | `length \| auto` | Its height: logical pixels, or a percentage of the parent; `auto` as for `width`. |
| `min_width` | `length` | The smallest width it takes. |
| `min_height` | `length` | The smallest height it takes. |
| `max_width` | `length` | The largest width it takes. |
| `max_height` | `length` | The largest height it takes: `max_height: 420`. |
| `size` | `length \| auto` | Its width and height at once: `size: 8`; `auto` as for `width`. |
| `grow` | `float` | Its share of the space left in its row or column: `grow: 1`. |
| `shrink` | `float` | How much it gives up when its row or column is too small: `shrink: 0` keeps its size (default 1). |
| `justify` | `Justify` | How its children share the main axis: `justify: space_between`. |
| `pad` | `insets` | Space inside its edge: one to four values (`pad: 0, $space.3`). |
| `margin` | `insets` | Space outside its edge: one to four values. |
| `gap` | `length` | Space between its children: `gap: $space.2`. |
| `align` | `Align` | Alignment of its children on the cross axis, or of a text's lines. |
| `place` | `Place` | `absolute` takes it out of the flow, placed by `x` and `y`. |
| `stagger` | `duration` | Delays each child's `enter` this much after the one before. |
| `x` | `length` | Horizontal offset; paint-only. |
| `y` | `length` | Vertical offset; paint-only. |
| `scale` | `float` | Scale about its centre; paint-only. |
| `rotate` | `angle` | Rotation about its centre; paint-only: `rotate: t * 20deg`. |
| `opacity` | `float` | Opacity, 0 to 1; paint-only. |
| `bg` | `paint` | Background paint: a colour or a gradient. |
| `color` | `color` | Inherited. Text and icon colour, inherited by every descendant. |
| `font` | `font` | Inherited. Font, inherited by every descendant: `"Inter" 13px 500`, `$font.ui`. |
| `weight` | `int` | Inherited. Font weight, inherited by every descendant: `weight: 600`. |
| `radius` | `corners \| full` | Corner radii: one value, four (`14, 14, 0, 0`), or `full` for a pill. |
| `corners` | `CornerStyle` | `squircle` for smooth corners. |
| `border` | `length, paint` | A border of a width and a paint: `border: 1, $border`. A gradient's angle may animate; only the ring repaints. |
| `shadow` | `shadow` | Drop shadows: `0 2px 8px $shadow.alpha(0.25)`, comma-separated. |
| `inner_shadow` | `shadow` | A shadow inside its edge. |
| `blur` | `length` | Blur behind it, done by the compositor: `blur: 24`. |
| `blur_fallback` | `BlurFallback` | What to draw when the compositor cannot blur. |
| `backdrop` | `Filter` | A filter over your own content behind it: `backdrop: blur(16)`. |
| `clip` | `bool` | Clips its children to its rounded shape. |
| `hit` | `HitArea \| none` | Its hit area: `hit: grow(6)` enlarges it for small targets; `hit: none` takes no input in its own box (the pointer passes through to what is below), while its children take theirs. On a `trigger: hover` popup that draws nothing, a top-level element with `hit: none` gives the popup's input region its children's boxes instead of its own. |
| `cursor` | `CursorShape` | The pointer's shape while it is over it: `cursor: pointer` on a link, `grab` on a handle (`when pressed { cursor: grabbing }`), `ew_resize` on a grip. The innermost node under the pointer with one decides, and while a press is held the one it went down on does; an `input` shows `text` unless it says otherwise, anything else the default arrow. Set through `wp_cursor_shape_v1`, or the cursor theme where the compositor lacks it. |
| `tooltip` | `text` | A tooltip shown on hover. |
| `filter` | `Filter \| [Filter]` | Colour filters on its subtree: `filter: grayscale(1)`, or a list. |
| `blend` | `Blend` | How it blends with what is below it. |
| `mask` | `Mask` | Masks its subtree: `fade(bottom, 24)`, `radial(…)`, `shape(cookie)`. |
| `glow` | `length, color` | A glow of a radius and a colour: `glow: 12, $accent.alpha(0.6)`. |
| `rim` | `Edge, color` | A lit edge: `rim: top, $fg.alpha(0.15)`. |
| `grain` | `float` | Film grain: `grain: 0.04`. |
| `morph` | `text` | A shared-element name: nodes with the same `morph` morph into each other across surfaces (`morph: "media"`). |
| `jelly` | `float` | Squash and stretch while dragged: `jelly: 0.4`. |
| `parallax` | `length` | Moves with the pointer, up to this far: `parallax: 6px`. |
| `tilt` | `angle` | Tilts toward the pointer, up to this angle: `tilt: 8deg`. |
| `shape` | `Shape` | A shape from the shape library; a change morphs by spring. |
| `stroke` | `length, paint` | An outline of a width and a paint, with styles: `stroke: 3, $accent { trim: 0, progress; cap: round }`. |
| `stroke.trim` | `float, float` | The part drawn: from a start to an end fraction. |
| `stroke.wave` | `float, length` | A wavy stroke: its amplitude and wavelength. |
| `stroke.cap` | `Cap` | The line caps. |
| `stroke.dash` | `length, length` | Dash and gap lengths. |
| `enter` | `Pose \| PoseName` | The pose it enters from: `enter { opacity: 0 }`, `popin(0.8)`, `slide(top)`, `fade` or `slidefade`. `exit` mirrors it unless given. |
| `exit` | `Pose \| PoseName` | The pose it leaves by; the subtree unmounts once it has played. |
| `transition` | `SwapTransition \| SwapKind` | How its content swaps on `if`, `pages` and image changes: `wipe(left)`, `disc`, `dissolve` or `pixelate`; `none` for no mask. |
| `drag` | `any` | Makes it a drag source carrying this value: `drag: pin`. |

| Event | |
| --- | --- |
| `on click` | A primary click. |
| `on secondary` | A secondary (right) click. |
| `on middle` | A middle click. |
| `on scroll(dy: float, dx: float)` | A scroll: `on scroll(dy) { … }`. |
| `on drop(value: any, at: int)` | Something was dropped on it: a `drag:` source's value or a `Drop` from another program, and the index it landed at. |
| `on key(key: Key)` | A key press while it has focus. |
| `on activate` | It was chosen: clicked, Enter while selected in a `list`, or Enter in an `input` with no `nav:` list. |

### `surface`

```strand
group surface: node
```

What every surface accepts.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `screens` | `Screens \| [text] \| text` | The monitors it is on: `all`, `focused`, or output names. |
| `layer` | `Layer` | Its layer-shell layer. |
| `open` | `<-> bool` | Whether it is shown. Bound two-way (`open: <-> open`), Escape, click-away and focus loss write false; on a `window` only the compositor's close and `w.close()` do. |
| `keyboard` | `Keyboard` | Keyboard focus: `none`, `on_demand` or `exclusive`. |
| `anchor` | `Anchor` | Where it sits on the screen: `anchor: top_right`. |
| `attach` | `Edge` | Grows out of an edge with concave fillets: `attach: top`. |
| `scrim` | `color` | A colour dimming what is behind it, on a `popup` or `panel`: `scrim: $shadow.alpha(0.3)`. A single-pixel buffer, so it costs nothing; a gradient has no single-pixel form. |
| `inhibit_idle` | `bool` | While it is shown, the compositor does not go idle (no screensaver, dimming or lock by timeout): `bar Top { inhibit_idle: caffeine }`. |

| Event | |
| --- | --- |
| `on show` | It was shown: `on show { query = "" }`. |
| `on hide` | It was hidden. |

## Elements

### `arc`

```strand
element arc: node
```

An arc or ring gauge: `arc { value: cpu.usage; sweep: 270deg; stroke:
4, $accent }`. Its line is its `stroke:`: the width (4 px unset), the
value's paint (else `color`, else `$accent`) and the styles (`cap`,
`dash`). Its box is square, `size:` (24 px unset), drawn on its
smaller side; `width` and `height` size the box too, never the line
(one `width` beside a `size:` and no `stroke:` is warned, its fix
`stroke`).

It takes no children.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `float` | How full it is, in `range` (0 to 1 when unset); a value outside it is drawn at its nearer end. |
| `range` | `(float \| auto, float \| auto) \| auto` | The values its ends stand for, as a `meter`'s: `range: 0, 100`, `range: auto` (0 to 1 when unset). |
| `sweep` | `angle` | The angle of the whole arc. |
| `track` | `paint` | The paint of the unfilled part (unset, the line's colour, else `color`, at 15%). |

### `bar`

```strand
element bar: surface
```

A bar, on every monitor with `screen` in scope.

It is a surface, written at the top level of a file.

Also every prop and event of [`surface`](#surface).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `edge` | `Edge` | The screen edge it sits on. |
| `exclusive` | `bool \| length` | Space it keeps from windows: `true` (the default) its thickness, a length in px that much (beyond its margin), `false` or `0` none (it overlaps them). |

| In scope | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `screen` | `Screen` | The monitor this instance is on: one instance per monitor. |

### `box`

```strand
element box: node
```

A plain box to style.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

### `button`

```strand
element button(text -> text): node
```

A button with a label: `button "‹" { on click { … } }`.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

### `canvas`

```strand
element canvas: node
```

Draws with code: `canvas { draw: (c) => … }`.

It takes no children.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `draw` | `fn(Canvas)` | Draws on the canvas. It runs again when what it reads changes, not every frame, so `t`, `wave(…)` and `noise` of `t` are refused in it (`check::time_in_canvas`): animate the canvas's own props (`rotate: t * 90deg`) or draw every frame with a `shader`. |

### `center`

```strand
element center: node
```

The centre part of a `split`, truly centred.

It may appear only directly inside `split`.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

### `col`

```strand
element col: node
```

Lays out its children in a column.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wrap` | `bool` | Runs its children on in another column when one is full, which needs a bounded height (`gap` stands between columns too; `align` and `justify` place them in each). |

### `effect`

```strand
element effect(EffectKind -> style): node
```

A built-in effect: `effect sparks { … }`.

It takes no children.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `speed` | `float` | How fast it runs; 1 is normal. |

### `end`

```strand
element end: node
```

The end part of a `split`.

It may appear only directly inside `split`.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

### `file`

```strand
element file(text -> path)
```

Keeps a file in step with the theme: `file "~/.cache/strand/colors.css"
{ template: "colors.css.tmpl"; run: ["reload-colors"] }`. Allowed at
the top level as well as in a tree, where `when` can change its
props; it draws nothing. Written atomically when its text would
change, and caught up at boot.

It takes no children.

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `template` | `text` | A template file (relative to the config), its holes `{{ expr }}` over the theme. |
| `text` | `any` | The content as one template expression, in place of `template:`. |
| `run` | `[text]` | A command run 200 ms after the file was last written; it needs `permit exec`. |

### `graph`

```strand
element graph(float | [float] -> value): node
```

A sparkline with its own history: `graph cpu.usage { history: 60s }`.
Only the new column repaints. Of a value that exists at file scope (a
service field, or an expression over service fields, file-level
`let`s, `state`s and settings, and constants) it shows the last
`history` as soon as it mounts, with time asleep as a gap; of one
tied to a list item, a component's parameter or `let`, an element's
state or the animation clock, or with a `history` that is not a
constant (a literal, or a file-level `let` of one), what came since
it mounted. A list is several series in one graph, each with its own
history, drawn over one another against one `range`, the first at the
back: `graph cpu.cores`, `graph [cpu.usage, memory.usage] { color:
$accent, $tertiary }`. Its columns are whole periods of the boot
clock, the same columns whenever its frames come, and its value does
not spring: `smooth` eases it.

It takes no children.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `history` | `duration` | How much history it keeps and shows (60 s when unset). |
| `range` | `(float \| auto, float \| auto) \| auto` | The values its bottom and top stand for: `range: 0, 100`; `auto` (or `auto` for one end, `range: 0, auto`) fits what it shows, on a 1, 2, 5 ladder, growing at once and narrowing only once the values shown fit four fifths of a smaller step (0 to 1 when unset). A value outside a fixed range is drawn at its nearer end. |
| `style` | `GraphStyle` | `line` (a line through its values), `steps` (each value held flat across its column, snapped to whole pixels, with square risers) or `bars` (a bar per value, `line_width` wide and `gap` apart). |
| `color` | `color \| [color]` | The line's colour (inherited when unset, as every node's), or a list, one per series (taken in turn when there are more series than colours; one colour serves them all). |
| `fill` | `paint \| [paint]` | The paint under the line, laid over the graph's box (a gradient fades as written: `linear(180deg, $accent.alpha(0.4), $accent.alpha(0))`), or a list, one per series; under `style: bars`, the bars' own paint. |
| `line_width` | `length` | The line's width (1.5 px when unset); under `style: bars`, each bar's (2 px when unset). |
| `gap` | `length` | Under `style: bars`, the space between bars (1 px when unset). |
| `smooth` | `float` | Smoothing: 0 (unset) follows the value; towards 1 each column moves less of the way to it. |

### `grid`

```strand
element grid: node
```

Lays out its children in a grid.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `int` | How many columns: `columns: 7`. |

### `icon`

```strand
element icon(text -> source): node
```

An icon by name: `icon "wifi"` looks in the config's `icons/` folder
(`wifi.svg` or `.png`, then `wifi-symbolic`), then the icon theme. A
`-symbolic` icon is drawn in `color`.

It takes no children.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

### `image`

```strand
element image(text? -> source): node
```

A picture by file path (`image "art.png"`, relative to the config
directory) or by icon name, as `icon` finds it. A null source shows
nothing.

It takes no children.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fit` | `Fit` | How the image fills its box: `cover`, `contain`, `fill` or `none`. |

### `input`

```strand
element input: node
```

A text field: `input { text: <-> query }`. Focused, it copies its
selection with Ctrl+C or Ctrl+Insert, cuts it with Ctrl+X or
Shift+Delete and pastes at the caret with Ctrl+V or Shift+Insert,
through the compositor's clipboard (a `password` copies nothing; a
paste becomes one line).

It takes no children.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `<-> text` | Its text, bound two-way. |
| `placeholder` | `text` | Shown while it is empty. |
| `type` | `InputKind` | `password` masks it, and the text it binds is a password: `check::secret_flow` warns where that reaches anything that shows, keeps or sends it, other than `auth.submit`, `polkit.respond`, `greetd.submit` and a network's `connect_with` (its length and whether it is empty are free to show). |
| `focus` | `bool` | Takes keyboard focus when shown, and again whenever it turns true while its surface has the keyboard (`focus: mode == search`). Tab and Shift+Tab move focus between a surface's inputs and lists, unless an `on key` around the focused one hears keys: then Tab is that handler's. |
| `nav` | `Node` | Routes arrow keys to a `list`: `nav: results`. |

### `letters`

```strand
element letters: node
```

Animates each letter of the `text` it is written in:
`text "hi" { letters { y: 2 * wave(1s, phase: index * 0.1) } }`. Its
props apply to each drawn letter in turn; `index` is the letter's
position.

It takes no children; may appear only directly inside `text`.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| In scope | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | `int` | The letter's position, from 0. |
| `count` | `int` | How many letters there are. |

### `list`

```strand
element list: node
```

Virtualised; arrow keys move the selection.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus` | `bool` | Takes keyboard focus when shown, and whenever it turns true (as an `input`'s); then arrows move its selection, Return activates the selected row, and Right opens a popup the row holds (a menu's submenu). |
| `snap` | `bool` | A wheel step or a touchpad's lift settles with a row's start at the view's start, as a `scroll`'s `snap`, rows not mounted yet included. |

### `lock`

```strand
element lock: surface
```

The lock screen, on `ext-session-lock`: on every monitor its
`screens:` picks (every one by default), one instance a monitor
sharing the lock's `state`s, timers and `on change` handlers. It is
exempt from reload and fails closed.

It is a surface, written at the top level of a file.

Also every prop and event of [`surface`](#surface).

| In scope | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `screen` | `Screen` | The monitor this instance is on; with `screens: focused` (or a pick no plugged monitor matches), the focused one, else the first, changing in place as focus moves. |

### `lottie`

```strand
element lottie(path -> source): node
```

A Lottie animation: `lottie "loader.json" { speed: 1 }`.

It takes no children.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `speed` | `float` | Playback speed; 1 is normal. |

### `merge`

```strand
element merge(length -> value): node
```

Goo merge: children melt together within the given distance.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

### `meter`

```strand
element meter(float -> value): node
```

A bar filled to its value: `meter level`, `meter memory.used {
range: 0, memory.total }`. Laid out taller than wide (`width: 6;
height: 80`), it fills upward from the bottom, without its `wave`.

It takes no children.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `float` | How full it is, in `range` (0 to 1 when unset); a value outside it is drawn at its nearer end. |
| `range` | `(float \| auto, float \| auto) \| auto` | The values its ends stand for: `range: 0, 100`; `auto` (or `auto` for one end, `range: 0, auto`) follows the values it showed in the last minute, on a 1, 2, 5 ladder (0 to 1 when unset); it moves when the meter draws, so it narrows at the first change after a burst is a minute old. |
| `track` | `paint` | The paint of the unfilled part. |
| `wave` | `float` | A wavy fill's amplitude; 0 is flat: `wave: media.playing ? 3 : 0`. |

### `osd`

```strand
element osd: surface
```

An on-screen display: on the focused monitor, in the overlay layer and
click-through; with `screens: all` (or names) on each of those, with
`screen` in scope.

It is a surface, written at the top level of a file.

Also every prop and event of [`surface`](#surface).

| In scope | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `screen` | `Screen` | With `screens:` other than `focused`: the monitor this instance is on. |

### `page`

```strand
element page(any -> name): node
```

A page of `pages`, shown when its value is `current`.

It may appear only directly inside `pages`; mounts its children only while shown.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

### `pages`

```strand
element pages: node
```

Shows one `page` at a time, with directional transitions. Hidden pages
unmount, so what they read stops.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `current` | `<-> any` | The value of the page shown, bound two-way. |

### `panel`

```strand
element panel: surface
```

A layer-shell panel: launchers, notification stacks, dashboards. With
`screens: all` (or names) it is on each of those monitors, one
instance per monitor with `screen` in scope, as a bar is.

It is a surface, written at the top level of a file.

Also every prop and event of [`surface`](#surface).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `exclusive` | `bool \| length` | Space it keeps from windows along the edge it is attached or anchored to (one edge: a corner or the centre keeps none, a warning): `true` its thickness, a length in px that much (beyond its margin), `false` or `0` none (the default; it overlaps them). |

| In scope | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `screen` | `Screen` | With `screens:` other than `focused`: the monitor this instance is on. |

### `particles`

```strand
element particles: node
```

Particles: `particles { rate: 20; life: 1.2s; sprite: dot(3) }`.

It takes no children.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rate` | `float` | Particles per second. |
| `life` | `duration` | How long each particle lives. |
| `sprite` | `Sprite` | What each particle looks like: `dot(3)`. |
| `glow` | `length` | The particles' glow radius. |
| `speed` | `float` | How fast the particles move. |

### `popup`

```strand
element popup: surface
```

Anchored to its parent element; nests (tray menus).

It mounts its children only while shown.

Also every prop and event of [`surface`](#surface).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` | `PopupTrigger` | What opens it: `open` (the default), its `open:` prop; `hover`, the pointer. A `trigger: hover` popup opens while the pointer is on the element it is anchored to (after `delay`), stays open while the pointer is on that element or on the popup (popups opened from it too), and 200 ms more to cross the gap, or while a drag that started in it goes on. It never takes the keyboard, and opening one closes the other `trigger: hover` popup open from the same surface. Its `open:` (never two-way) opens it from code and holds it open while true; then the pointer holds it as usual. |
| `delay` | `duration` | How long the pointer rests on the element before a `trigger: hover` popup opens. At once by default. |
| `grace` | `duration` | How long a `trigger: hover` popup stays open after the pointer leaves both it and its element, to cross the gap. 200 ms by default. |
| `anchor` | `Anchor \| PopupAnchor` | Where it opens: below the element it is anchored to (the default; a submenu beside its row, on the side `left`, `right`, `top` or `bottom` names), or `pointer`, where the press on its element that opened it went down: a context menu at the click, down and to the right of it, kept inside the screen. Opened with no press (a key, a timer, a hover) it opens at its element; a later press on its element that leaves it open moves it there. |

| Event | |
| --- | --- |
| `on dismiss` | Escape or a click away closed it. |

### `row`

```strand
element row: node
```

Lays out its children in a row.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wrap` | `bool` | Runs its children on in another row when one is full (`gap` stands between rows too; `align` and `justify` place them in each). |

### `scroll`

```strand
element scroll: node
```

Scrolls its content.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `axis` | `Axis` | Which way it scrolls: `vertical` (the default), `horizontal` (its children in a row; a wheel without a sideways motion scrolls it when no scroll around it can move along y) or `both`. A touchpad gesture keeps the axis its first motion took until the fingers lift. |
| `snap` | `bool` | A wheel step or a touchpad's lift settles with a child's start at the view's start (the end of the content too): one wheel notch moves to the next child, and a fling lands on the child nearest where it would have stopped. |

### `segmented`

```strand
element segmented: node
```

One choice of several: `segmented { options: Look; value: <-> theme.look }`.

It takes no children.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `any` | The choices: an enum or a list. |
| `value` | `<-> any` | The chosen one, bound two-way. |

### `shader`

```strand
element shader(path -> source): node
```

Your own WGSL shader: `shader "aurora.wgsl" { u_speed: 0.4 }`. Props
named `u_…` are its uniforms; it is checked with naga and hot-reloaded.

It takes no children; accepts any prop starting with `u_` (a shader uniform).

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

### `slider`

```strand
element slider: node
```

A slider: `slider { value: <-> audio.sink.volume }`. Dragged, it
writes values in its `range`: `slider { value: <-> percent; range: 0,
100 }`. Laid out taller than wide (`width: 24; height: 160`), it runs
upward: its value grows from the bottom (its written `width` and
`height` decide, else its laid-out box; one growing from a written 0,
`width: 0; grow: 1`, runs along that axis; a drag keeps the way it
began).

It takes no children.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `<-> float` | Its value, in `range` (0 to 1 when unset), bound two-way; a value outside it is drawn at its nearer end. |
| `range` | `float, float` | The values its ends stand for: `range: 0, 100` (0 to 1 when unset). A drag writes values between them. |
| `track` | `paint` | The paint of the unfilled track. |
| `step` | `float` | A drag moves in whole steps of this, in `range`'s units from its low end (`range: 0, 100; step: 5`), and writes the decimal they spell (`step: 0.1` writes `0.9`, never `0.90000004`); unset, it moves freely. |

### `spacer`

```strand
element spacer: node
```

Takes up the space left.

It takes no children.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

### `spectrum`

```strand
element spectrum(AudioDevice -> source): node
```

An audio spectrum: `spectrum audio.sink { bars: 48; style: mirror }`.
It stops while the audio is silent.

It takes no children.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bars` | `int` | How many bars. |
| `smooth` | `float` | Smoothing, 0 to 1. |
| `style` | `SpectrumStyle` | `bars`, `mirror`, `wave` or `line`. |

### `split`

```strand
element split: node
```

Start, centre and end, with a truly centred middle.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

### `stack`

```strand
element stack: node
```

Stacks its children on top of each other.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

### `start`

```strand
element start: node
```

The start part of a `split`.

It may appear only directly inside `split`.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

### `svg`

```strand
element svg(path -> source): node
```

An SVG whose layers bind by id: `svg "icon.svg" { #needle { … } }`.
A `#id { … }` block takes `rotate`, `scale`, `x`, `y`, `opacity` and
`fill` for that layer.

It takes no children; holds `#name { … }` selectors.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fit` | `Fit` | How the drawing fills its box. |
| `fill` | `paint` | One colour every shape takes (in a `#id { … }` block: that layer's). |

### `text`

```strand
element text(text -> text): node
```

Text: `text clock.format("%a %d  %H:%M")`.

It takes no children but [`letters`](#letters).

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ellipsis` | `Ellipsis` | Where overflowing text is cut with `…`: `ellipsis: end`. |
| `max_lines` | `int` | At most this many lines. |
| `marks` | `[Range]` | Character ranges to highlight: `marks: h.ranges`. |
| `mark_color` | `paint` | The paint of `marks`. |
| `markup` | `Markup` | `basic` renders simple markup. |
| `roll` | `bool` | Rolls the digits when the number changes: `roll: true`. |
| `text_stroke` | `length, paint` | An outline around the letters: `text_stroke: 1, $bg`. |
| `fill` | `paint` | The paint of the letters: `fill: linear(…)`. |

### `thumbnail`

```strand
element thumbnail(Window | Screen -> source): node
```

A live thumbnail of a window (`thumbnail w`), or a still of a screen,
taken each time it is shown (`thumbnail screen`). The still is taken
before the surface showing it appears, so on its own screen it shows
what was there, not that surface; one shown later in a surface
already on screen is taken then, and holds that surface. Inside a
`lock` it is the still taken just before the lock covered the
screen; a monitor plugged in while locked (a replug included) has
none, and draws nothing, so the lock's own `bg` shows there. With
nothing to show it is `blank` (`thumbnail screen { id: still }`, then
`when still.blank { … }`).

It takes no children.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fit` | `Fit` | How the thumbnail fills its box. |

### `tooltip`

```strand
element tooltip: node
```

A tooltip with content of its own.

It mounts its children only while shown.

Also every prop and event of [`node`](#node).

### `window`

```strand
element window: surface
```

A window the compositor manages (`xdg_toplevel`): it tiles, floats,
moves, minimises and shows in task bars as an app's window does
(a settings window, a picker). The compositor decides its size: its
`width` and `height` (its content's while unset) are the size it asks
for, and its `min_*`/`max_*` the sizes it takes. Its compositor's
close writes its `open: <-> x` false. Its own `focused` is true while
the compositor has it focused, and `maximized`, `fullscreen`,
`tiled` and `decorated` follow the compositor (`id: w` and
`w.maximized`); `w.move()`, `w.resize(edge)`, `w.minimize()`,
`w.maximize()`, `w.fullscreen()` and `w.close()` ask it.
The compositor places, stacks and focuses it, so the `surface`
props that place a layer surface (`screens`, `layer`, `anchor`,
`keyboard`, `attach`, `scrim`, and `margin` on it) are load errors
(`check::window_prop`), and `screen` is not in scope in it. Escape
and focus loss leave it open; only the compositor's close and
`w.close()` write its `open` false.

It is a surface, written at the top level of a file.

Also every prop and event of [`surface`](#surface).

| Prop | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `text` | The title the compositor shows: `title: "Settings"`. Its name while unset. |
| `app_id` | `text` | The app id compositor rules match: `strand-<Name>` while unset. |
| `decorations` | `Decorations` | Who draws its title bar and borders: `server` (the default), the compositor where it offers to (`w.decorated`), or `none`, the config. |
